[中文](#cn-v0.1.0) | [English](#en-v0.1.0)

承接 `v0.0.11`。这一版把 [miliastra-beyond-simulator](https://github.com/1475505/miliastra-beyond-simulator) 的引擎**吸收进本仓**，
在游戏之外长出「搭界面 → 跑 Lua → 出画面 → **自测逻辑**」的完整闭环：新增 1 个工具 `miliastra_sim`（12 个 op）、
会话区三个视图、面板上真能试玩。因为吸收了上游代码，许可同步换成 **GPL-3.0-only**（既有 `≤0.0.11` 仍按 Apache-2.0）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.1.0">新增功能</h3>

- **`miliastra_sim`：内置千星模拟器**。`state` / `patch` / `play` / `verify` / `controls` / `shot` / `keys` / `export` / `import` / `load` / `save` / `reset`；
  用户 Lua **一律跑在可终止的 Worker 里**（默认单次操作 8 秒超时后 `terminate`），工作区固定在插件数据目录，
  **不碰游戏存档、地图与活文件**，也不需要打开游戏或官方编辑器。
- **`op=verify`：AI 自测逻辑的主入口**。一次调用 = **操作 + 断言 + 判定**，引擎在全新会话里**确定性重放**（可重复）：
  `steps[]` 八种操作（按键 / 点击 / 按名字点 / 写变量 / 发信号 / 切视角 / 暂停 / 继续），
  `expect[]` 六种断言（日志 / 控件字段 / 变量 / 信号 / 控件存在 / 自写 Lua 查询）。**时序可以省**（默认查最后一个事件之后 0.1 秒），
  没过时给一条**人话提示**：第几条断言、期望 vs 实际、失败时刻与帧号。
- **一组用例一次跑**（`cases[]`）：每个用例各开一个全新会话，**互不影响**，所以能当回归套件；默认跑完全部，也可第一个不过就停。
- **失败自动取证**：判定没过时顺带回**失败点附近的一帧画面**（先冻结 Worker 时钟，否则 30FPS 会继续往前走）
  和**运行时的控件名清单** —— 写错控件名时照着清单改，不用回头问人。
- **写断言前先看控件**（`op=controls`）：只回「有哪些控件 / 叫什么名 / 什么类型 / 第几层」四个字段（`state` 的每条有 12 个），
  实测一行**不到 `state` 同行的 1/3**；也能看**运行中**会话的树，即脚本动态创建出来的那批。
- **会话区三个视图**（初级功能 / 高级功能 / 模拟器）+ 侧边栏浮层入口；**面板上真能玩**：连帧 5 帧/秒、
  点画布任意位置、按键、设备五档、人数 1–8、切视角、单步。
- **GIA 导出与导回**（写回能力，导出落在模拟器工作区）。

### 体验优化

- 面板三页**各自独立平铺**（去掉混在一起的「全部」页），每页都占满高度。
- 文档补一层「**你手上在做的事 → 读哪个文件**」：新增模拟器与视图、融合需求边界与工单、**上游源码索引与吸收地图**
  （全量上游源码在哪、搬了什么、没搬的该读哪篇 —— 含上游的 esbuild 打包脚本与它自己的 DSH 插件）。

### 问题修复

- **初级页第三列一直空着**：根因是 CSS 顺序（连帧填充规则被后面的基础规则盖掉），不是布局逻辑；修掉并加断言钉住顺序。
- **切换设备后人数悄悄掉回 1**，再切视角就报 `playerIndex must be an integer 1-1`：现在人数自动沿用，错误信息也说明原因。
- **运行时的控件树其实是嵌套的**（编辑器树是拍平的）：只数顶层会把控件**少算一个数量级**（实测 1 vs 17）。
  这条是**跑演示时抓到的**，不是看代码推断的 —— 现在统一先拍平再数，并留下绊线断言。

### 其他变更

- 许可 **Apache-2.0 → GPL-3.0-only**，四处声明一致；`NOTICE` 标注上游仓库与提交锚点。
- 测试 **484 项**全绿（`readme-test` 14 / `smoke` 49 / `deploy-test` 30 / `probe-deploy-test` 16 / `lualint-test` 32 /
  `shot-test` 103 / `sim-test` 68 / `client-render-test` 43，外加**搬入的引擎测试 129 项**一并进 `npm test`）。
- 两条老规矩不变：**Host 半边是启动快照**（改 `index.js` / `lib/*.mjs` 要重启 `dsh web`；只改 `lib/client.js` 刷新页面即可）；
  **面板没有的功能不代表工具没有** —— 工具 schema 才是唯一真身。
- ⚠️ **已知边界**：导出的 `.gia` **能否被官方编辑器接受仍未验证**（引擎侧往返已成立，真机导入只能人做）；
  **模拟器通过 ≠ 真机通过**；浏览器 WebGL 试玩页未搬（面板用 PNG 帧驱动），1–8 人是本地多客户端模拟、不含真实联机。

**Full Changelog**: [v0.0.11...v0.1.0](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.0.11...v0.1.0)

---

This release follows `v0.0.11`. It **absorbs the engine** of [miliastra-beyond-simulator](https://github.com/1475505/miliastra-beyond-simulator)
into this repository and grows a full loop outside the game — build UI → run Lua → render frames → **self-test logic**:
one new tool `miliastra_sim` (12 ops), three views in the conversation area, and a panel you can actually play in.
Because upstream code is now included, the license moves to **GPL-3.0-only** (existing `≤0.0.11` stays Apache-2.0).

<h3 id="en-v0.1.0">New Features</h3>

- **`miliastra_sim`: a built-in Miliastra simulator.** `state` / `patch` / `play` / `verify` / `controls` / `shot` / `keys` / `export` / `import` / `load` / `save` / `reset`.
  Your Lua **always runs in a killable worker** (8 s per operation, then `terminate`), the workspace is fixed inside the plugin data directory,
  and it **never touches game saves, map files, or live script files** — no game client or official editor required.
- **`op=verify`: the main entry point for AI self-testing.** One call = **actions + assertions + verdict**, replayed **deterministically** in a fresh session:
  eight step kinds (key / click / click-by-name / set variable / send signal / switch view / pause / resume) and
  six assertion kinds (log / control field / variable / signal / control exists / your own Lua query). **Timing can be omitted**
  (it defaults to 0.1 s after the last event), and a failure comes back with a plain-language pointer: which assertion, expected vs actual, time and frame.
- **A whole suite in one call** (`cases[]`): every case runs in its own fresh session, so cases **cannot leak into each other** — usable as a regression suite.
  Runs all cases by default, or stops at the first failure.
- **Automatic failure evidence**: a failing verdict also returns **a frame near the failure point** (the worker clock is frozen first, otherwise 30 FPS keeps moving)
  and **the runtime list of control names** — so a wrong control name can be fixed from the evidence instead of a round trip.
- **Look at the controls before writing assertions** (`op=controls`): only four fields per row (id / name / kind / depth — `state` gives twelve),
  measured at **under a third of the bytes of the same row in `state`**; it can also read the **running** session's tree, i.e. the controls a script created at runtime.
- **Three views in the conversation area** (basic / advanced / simulator) plus the sidebar overlay entry; **the panel is actually playable**:
  5 FPS live frames, click anywhere on the canvas, key presses, five device canvases, 1–8 players, view switching, single-step.
- **GIA export and import** (write-back, exported into the simulator workspace).

### Improvements

- The three panel pages are now **independently tiled** (the mixed "all" page is gone) and each one fills the height.
- Docs gained a "**what you're doing → which file to read**" layer: the simulator and views, the fusion requirements and work orders,
  and an **upstream source index and absorption map** (where the full upstream source lives, what was absorbed, what to read next —
  including upstream's esbuild packaging script and its own DSH plugin).

### Bug Fixes

- **The third column of the basic page stayed empty**: the root cause was CSS ordering (a fill rule overridden by a later base rule), not layout logic; fixed, with an assertion pinning the order.
- **Switching device silently reset the player count to 1**, after which switching views failed with `playerIndex must be an integer 1-1`; the count is now carried over and the error explains itself.
- **The runtime control tree is nested while the editor tree is flat**: counting only the top level **under-counted controls by an order of magnitude** (measured 1 vs 17).
  This was caught by **running a demo**, not by reading code — the tree is now flattened before counting, with a tripwire assertion left behind.

### Chores

- License **Apache-2.0 → GPL-3.0-only**, consistent in all four places; `NOTICE` records the upstream repository and commit anchor.
- **484 tests** green (`readme-test` 14 / `smoke` 49 / `deploy-test` 30 / `probe-deploy-test` 16 / `lualint-test` 32 /
  `shot-test` 103 / `sim-test` 68 / `client-render-test` 43, plus the **129 absorbed engine tests** now running under `npm test`).
- Two rules are unchanged: **the Host half is a startup snapshot** (restart `dsh web` after changing `index.js` / `lib/*.mjs`; a page refresh is enough for `lib/client.js`),
  and **a feature missing from the panel does not mean the tool lacks it** — the tool schema is the single source of truth.
- ⚠️ **Known limits**: whether an exported `.gia` is **accepted by the official editor is still unverified** (the engine round-trip holds; a real import can only be done by hand);
  **passing in the simulator is not passing on a real device**; the browser WebGL play page was not absorbed (the panel drives PNG frames), and 1–8 players is a local multi-client simulation with no real networking.

**Full Changelog**: [v0.0.11...v0.1.0](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-miliastra/compare/v0.0.11...v0.1.0)
